notes.title: Update v.1.0.4
notes.notes:
Development is underway on Light Up the Holidays once more and I'm excited to announce the Halloween update for 2019. It features some spooky decorations to change things up in your scenes.

And lastly, development continues for Sandbox mode where you will be able to build your own houses to decorate. It should hopefully be ready in time for the holidays this year.

Happy Halloween!
